title: Okayama Korakuen — official admission and hours

facts.fact: Garden winter opening October1–March19 is08:00–17:00, last admission16:45.
Summer period March20–September30 is07:30–18:00, last admission17:45; seasons must not be confused.
Published adult15–64 individual admission is500yen; no unverified transport fares or universal discounts.
Garden/castle combined ticket is800yen, with restrictions for closing days or special exhibitions; re-entry is not generally permitted.
A new commercial photo/video shoot inside the garden requires advance permission, at least10days; this task commissions no shoot.
